thread:
raj.support: FYI, urgent escalation — FluxHealth trial activation is blocked. Their SSO/OAuth exchange returns 403 for new seats, so onboarding flow fails. Customer is at 45% activation and this is likely to push them off the trial. Need CS to take point on comms and remediation. @emily.cs can you own?

emily.cs: On it. Can you drop the error snippet and any tenant id / region? I can triage with infra + docs. :wave:

raj.support: tenant_id=flux-tn-81, region=us-west-2. Here's the proxied token exchange response we're seeing from their logs:

```
POST /oauth/token HTTP/1.1
Host: auth.fluxhealth.com
Content-Type: application/x-www-form-urlencoded

{"error":"access_denied","error_description":"client_credentials_not_allowed","status":403}
```

raj.support: They say it started after they toggled the new SSO enforcement flag yesterday. No config changes on our side, but their provisioning requests are failing and our provisioning queue has ~120 pending seats.

maria.csm: Thanks for the heads up. I'll coordinate customer comms. Proposed quick comms plan: 1) immediate acknowledgement to customer (ETA 1h) 2) temporary workaround (manual seat grant + rollback SSO flag) 3) follow-up fix + postmortem and offer extended trial if impacted. Agree?

emily.cs: Agree with comms plan. Quick question — can support hand out seats manually while we debug? If ops can unlock the queue, we keep the CX warm.

raj.support: We can manual-grant up to 50 seats via admin portal, but will need CSM approval for more. Also opened ticket INF-4729 with infra.

liam.ae: Looping me in — I'm meeting the FluxHealth lead at 15:00 PT. Please have a one-pager ready I can share on the call (status, workaround, ETA). I'll join the sync. :thumbsup:

emily.cs: Copy. Maria — can you draft the one-pager? I'll add technical details. Also adding temporary playbook steps here:
- Message customer acknowledging impact and next steps
- Offer manual seat grant and walk through admin flow
- If customer cannot rollback SSO flag, enable legacy token path for 72 hours
- Schedule joint debug call within 2 hours

maria.csm: Drafting now. Target to post to the thread and ping @liam.ae in 25m. Who should we loop for compliance on the legacy token path?

raj.support: ops-bot created incident INF-4729 and assigned to eng-runtime. Tagging @eng-runtime on the call is helpful.

ops-bot: Incident INF-4729 created — severity P1 (provisioning blocked), assigned: eng-runtime, sla: 4h. Updates will be posted here.

emily.cs: Quick ask for support: can you collect a sample failing request with headers (sanitized) and the earliest timestamp we saw the errors? That helps eng-runtime replicate.

raj.support: Uploaded sanitized HAR + earliest failing timestamp to the incident ticket. Link: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INF-4729 :eyes:

maria.csm: OK — plan: I'll send the acknowledgement to FluxHealth now, offer the manual seat grant and propose a 14:30 PT debug call. Liam — I'll have the one-pager ready before your 15:00 PT check-in.

emily.cs: I'll prep the runbook for manual seat grant and the fallback enable steps. Will post checklist here when ready.

liam.ae: Thanks team. Keep me posted in this thread and add any exec-level bullets if the customer asks about renewal implications.

raj.support: Thanks all — marking this as high priority handoff to CS. If anything blocks manual grants, ping me immediately. :rocket:
